name: Do sheer descent waterfalls require a dedicated pump?

mainEntity.name: Do sheer descent waterfalls require a dedicated pump?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, for optimal performance and control, a sheer descent waterfall typically requires a dedicated pump separate from your pool's filtration pump. This allows you to operate the water feature independently, control the flow rate precisely to achieve the desired sheet effect, and prevent any adverse impact on your pool's circulation and filtration system. The pump size will depend on the sheer descent's width and desired water flow.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, a dedicated pump is usually required for a sheer descent to ensure optimal performance, independent operation, and precise flow control.
